data_changes.change: added dead_1 Cinderrest (type dead, abundant dross, scarce none, dross_buy 5, dross_sell 4, x -340 y -120); added dross_sell 14 at Voltara and 12 at Ashgate. Placeholders. No existing price changed.

added dead_2 Greywake (type dead, abundant nullglass, nullglass_buy 12, nullglass_sell 10, x 700 y 300, literal name); added nullglass_sell 30 at s2_p2 and 34 at s2_p4. Placeholders. Source line added.
new type dead (abundant none, scarce none, own_goods true: the planet row names its own resource).
new keys skill_cost_M1 2, skill_cost_M2 3, skill_cost_F1 3 (spec), dead_danger_max 5, dead_danger_rise 1, dead_follow_cycles 4 (default delay for a follow-up). No existing value changed.

mechanics.commodities: dross and nullglass join the list through the planet base_prices pattern; main._open_system now appends goods a newly opened system brings (in place, engine and storage share the array).
mechanics.skills: SkillTree.EXTRA puts M1, M2, F1 in branch B (Research); prereqs B1 / M1 / M1+M2; normal locks apply (only B1 exempt). Names fall back to Cold Survey, Deep Cut, Fabrication Licence until SK_M1_NAME etc exist. EndingPicker branch counts and tiers are unchanged (M and F ids do not count toward branch B).
mechanics.gate: RouteEngine.check_connection: new route from dead_1 needs M1, from dead_2 needs M2. Reason text NOT_DEAD_NEEDS_SKILL (fallback 'Needs {skill}.'). Saved routes keep loading (new_route false).
mechanics.danger: game/dead_worlds.gd: meter 0..dead_danger_max per planet id. main._tick_danger after settle: +dead_danger_rise per world with a running route out of it (once per world). Save key danger {planet_id: value}. Planet panel line 'Danger: n of 5' (node DangerLine, text id PLANET_DANGER with fallback). main.danger_of(i), main.dead.change(id, delta).
mechanics.event_hooks: events.json keys: choice follow_id + follow_after (cycles, default balance dead_follow_cycles); event keys scheduled_only (bool) and on_mine ('dead_1', 'dead_2' or 'any': fires once when a route first starts out of that world). Any follow_id target, scheduled_only and on_mine events are kept out of the random pick. New tag [danger: Planet, +1] (negative lowers). Effect line id NOT_EVENT_EFFECT_DANGER (fallback). Schedule is saved in events.scheduled; old saves have none. Scheduled events fire at the start of the due cycle and replace that cycle's random event.
mechanics.fix: A choice without popup_id used to leave the event notice open; it now dismisses like a plain event.

save_notes: New keys danger and events.scheduled; old saves load with none. RISK: dead_1 is index 3 in planets.json, so system 2 planets moved from index 3-6 to 4-7 (Greywake 8). A save made before this build with system 2 open points routes, orders and storage at the wrong planets. System-1-only saves are unaffected. No migration written.
